create_hanabi_envs: create multiple HanabiEnv game instances with configurable players, hand size, seed, and exploration parameters
create_env_threads: create threaded HanabiVecEnv loops with actors and push them into a rela Context for parallel execution
create_actgroup_vdn: create an ActGroup with VDN method that builds R2D2Actor instances across model runners and devices
start_actgroup_runners: start all model runners in an ActGroup to begin inference and priority computation loops
update_actgroup_model: update the model on all BatchRunner instances in an ActGroup with a new agent
